legacy_unverified.uses: Treatment of HIV-1 infection, usually combined with other antiretrovirals.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor; blocks HIV DNA synthesis.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Nausea, fatigue, headache; rare but severe hypersensitivity in HLA-B*57:01 carriers.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: HLA-B*57:01 positive status (absolute contraindication per CPIC/FDA label).
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — test before first use
alternatives: Tenofovir-based regimen (e.g. tenofovir/emtricitabine)

legacy_unverified.uses: Long-term management of gout and hyperuricemia.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Inhibits xanthine oxidase, lowering uric acid production.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Rash, GI upset; rare but life-threatening SJS/TEN in HLA-B*58:01 carriers.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: HLA-B*58:01 positive status, especially in patients of Han Chinese, Thai, or Korean descent.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — consider testing before use
alternatives: Febuxostat (with caution)
Probenecid-based alternative

legacy_unverified.uses: Management of tonic-clonic and partial seizures; status epilepticus.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Blocks voltage-gated sodium channels, stabilising neuronal membranes.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Gingival hyperplasia, ataxia, sedation; teratogenic in pregnancy.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Reduced-function CYP2C9 alleles; pregnancy (fetal hydantoin syndrome).
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — reduce starting dose ~25% in poor metabolizers
alternatives: Levetiracetam (minimal CYP involvement)

legacy_unverified.uses: Autoimmune disease and transplant rejection prophylaxis.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Converted to 6-thioguanine nucleotides that disrupt DNA synthesis in proliferating cells.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Bone-marrow suppression, hepatotoxicity, infection risk.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: TPMT or NUDT15 deficiency without major dose reduction.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — reduce dose 10-fold or select alternative
alternatives: Substantially reduced-dose azathioprine under specialist monitoring
Mycophenolate mofetil (specialist-guided)

legacy_unverified.uses: Lowering LDL cholesterol to reduce cardiovascular risk.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, reducing hepatic cholesterol synthesis.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Myalgia, elevated liver enzymes; rare rhabdomyolysis.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Active liver disease; caution in SLCO1B1 reduced-function carriers at high doses; caution in pregnancy.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — avoid high dose or select alternative statin
alternatives: Rosuvastatin or pravastatin at standard dose (less SLCO1B1-dependent)

legacy_unverified.uses: Prevention of thrombotic events after ACS, stenting, or stroke.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Prodrug activated by CYP2C19 to irreversibly block platelet P2Y12 receptors.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Bleeding, bruising, GI upset.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Poor CYP2C19 metabolizer status in high-risk cardiovascular settings.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — consider alternative antiplatelet
alternatives: Prasugrel or ticagrelor (not CYP2C19-dependent)

legacy_unverified.uses: Mild-to-moderate pain relief and cough suppression.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Prodrug metabolized by CYP2D6 into morphine, which produces the analgesic effect.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Sedation, constipation, respiratory depression at high morphine exposure.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: CYP2D6 ultrarapid metabolizer status; children under 12; post-tonsillectomy/adenoidectomy patients (FDA boxed warning).
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — avoid, use alternative analgesic
alternatives: Non-codeine analgesic (e.g. morphine with caution, or non-opioid options)

legacy_unverified.uses: First-line treatment for many bacterial infections (ENT, respiratory, urinary).
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Inhibits bacterial cell-wall synthesis via penicillin-binding proteins.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: GI upset, rash; anaphylaxis in true beta-lactam allergy.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Documented IgE-mediated penicillin/beta-lactam allergy.
legacy_unverified.cpic: Not a PGx marker — direct allergy contraindication
alternatives: Azithromycin or doxycycline (non-beta-lactam alternative)

legacy_unverified.uses: Treatment of UTIs, PJP pneumonia prophylaxis, some GI infections.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Dual blockade of bacterial folate synthesis (dihydrofolate reductase + synthase).
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Rash, GI upset, hyperkalemia; severe skin reactions in sulfa-sensitive patients.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Documented sulfonamide allergy.
legacy_unverified.cpic: Not a PGx marker — direct allergy contraindication
alternatives: Doxycycline or nitrofurantoin depending on indication

legacy_unverified.uses: Pain, inflammation, and fever relief.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Non-selective COX-1/COX-2 inhibition, reducing prostaglandin synthesis.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: GI irritation/bleeding, renal impairment risk, fluid retention.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Documented NSAID hypersensitivity; significant renal impairment; late pregnancy.
legacy_unverified.cpic: Not a PGx marker — direct allergy contraindication
alternatives: Acetaminophen (paracetamol) for analgesia/fever

legacy_unverified.uses: First-line therapy for type 2 diabetes.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Reduces hepatic glucose production and improves peripheral insulin sensitivity.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: GI upset, vitamin B12 deficiency with long-term use; rare lactic acidosis.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Significant renal impairment (eGFR <30, accumulation risk of lactic acidosis).
legacy_unverified.cpic: No CPIC guideline — renal function is the key prescribing constraint
alternatives: Renally-adjusted alternative agent (e.g. DPP-4 inhibitor) under specialist guidance

legacy_unverified.uses: Hypothyroidism management.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Synthetic T4, converted peripherally to active T3.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Palpitations, weight change, insomnia if over-replaced.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Untreated adrenal insufficiency; acute MI (relative).
legacy_unverified.cpic: No CPIC guideline for this drug

legacy_unverified.uses: Prevention and treatment of thromboembolic disease (AF, DVT/PE, mechanical heart valves).
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Inhibits vitamin K epoxide reductase (VKORC1), reducing synthesis of clotting factors II, VII, IX, X.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Bleeding, bruising; teratogenic in pregnancy (warfarin embryopathy).
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Active major bleeding; pregnancy; VKORC1/CYP2C9 variants requiring dose individualization.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — use genotype-guided dosing algorithm
alternatives: Direct oral anticoagulant (e.g. apixaban) where clinically appropriate

legacy_unverified.uses: Treatment of invasive aspergillosis and other serious fungal infections.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Inhibits fungal CYP51-dependent ergosterol synthesis; itself metabolized by CYP2C19.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Visual disturbances, hepatotoxicity, QT prolongation.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Poor CYP2C19 metabolizer status without dose/monitoring adjustment.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — adjust dose or select alternative antifungal
alternatives: Isavuconazole or therapeutic drug monitoring-guided dosing

legacy_unverified.uses: Adjuvant hormonal therapy for estrogen-receptor-positive breast cancer.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Prodrug activated by CYP2D6 to endoxifen, which blocks estrogen receptor signaling.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Hot flashes, thromboembolism risk, endometrial changes.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Poor CYP2D6 metabolizer status may reduce therapeutic benefit.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — consider alternative endocrine therapy in poor metabolizers
alternatives: Aromatase inhibitor (postmenopausal patients) per oncology guidance

legacy_unverified.uses: Chemotherapy for colorectal, breast, and other solid tumors.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Inhibits thymidylate synthase, blocking DNA synthesis in rapidly dividing cells.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Myelosuppression, mucositis, diarrhea, hand-foot syndrome.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: DPYD deficiency without major dose reduction; known complete DPD deficiency.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — reduce dose substantially or avoid
alternatives: Substantially reduced starting dose or alternative regimen under oncology guidance

legacy_unverified.uses: Oral chemotherapy for colorectal and breast cancer.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Prodrug converted to 5-fluorouracil in tumor tissue; inhibits thymidylate synthase.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Hand-foot syndrome, diarrhea, myelosuppression.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: DPYD deficiency without major dose reduction.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — reduce dose substantially or avoid
alternatives: Substantially reduced starting dose or alternative regimen under oncology guidance

legacy_unverified.uses: Chemotherapy for colorectal cancer, often in combination regimens.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Active metabolite SN-38 inhibits topoisomerase I; cleared via UGT1A1 glucuronidation.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Neutropenia, diarrhea (early and late-onset), nausea.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: UGT1A1*28 homozygosity without dose reduction.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — reduce starting dose in poor metabolizers
alternatives: Reduced starting dose under oncology guidance

legacy_unverified.uses: Management of partial and generalized seizures, trigeminal neuralgia, bipolar disorder.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Blocks voltage-gated sodium channels, stabilising neuronal membranes.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Dizziness, diplopia, hyponatremia; rare but severe cutaneous reactions.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: HLA-B*15:02 positive status (strongly associated with SJS/TEN, especially in Southeast Asian ancestry).
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — avoid if HLA-B*15:02 positive
alternatives: Levetiracetam or an alternative anticonvulsant not associated with HLA-B*15:02 risk

legacy_unverified.uses: Management of partial-onset seizures; alternative to carbamazepine.

legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Dizziness, hyponatremia, sedation.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: HLA-B*15:02 positive status warrants caution given cross-reactivity with carbamazepine.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — use with caution if HLA-B*15:02 positive
alternatives: Levetiracetam or an alternative anticonvulsant

legacy_unverified.uses: Treatment of major depressive disorder.

legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Nausea, sexual dysfunction, QT prolongation at higher exposure.

legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — consider dose reduction or alternative
alternatives: Dose reduction or an SSRI less dependent on CYP2C19

legacy_unverified.uses: Treatment of major depressive disorder and generalized anxiety disorder.

legacy_unverified.contraindications: Poor CYP2C19 metabolizer status at higher doses.

legacy_unverified.uses: Depression, neuropathic pain, migraine prophylaxis.

legacy_unverified.uses: Non-stimulant treatment for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder.

legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Decreased appetite, insomnia, elevated heart rate/blood pressure.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Poor CYP2D6 metabolizer status without dose titration.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — lower starting dose with careful titration

legacy_unverified.uses: Prevention of chemotherapy- and postoperative-induced nausea and vomiting.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Blocks serotonin 5-HT3 receptors centrally and peripherally; cleared via CYP2D6.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Headache, constipation, QT prolongation at high doses.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: CYP2D6 ultrarapid metabolizer status may reduce clinical effect.
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level B — consider alternative antiemetic if inadequate response

legacy_unverified.uses: Management of GERD, peptic ulcer disease, H. pylori eradication regimens.
legacy_unverified.mechanism: Irreversibly inhibits the gastric H+/K+-ATPase; metabolized substantially via CYP2C19.
legacy_unverified.sideEffects: Headache, GI upset; long-term use linked to B12/magnesium deficiency.
legacy_unverified.contraindications: Generally well tolerated across metabolizer types; monitor if co-prescribed with CYP2C19-dependent drugs (e.g. clopidogrel).
legacy_unverified.cpic: CPIC Level A — standard dosing usually appropriate; monitor interactions
alternatives: Standard dosing typically appropriate; review co-prescribed CYP2C19-dependent drugs
